title: NSX Policy client with in-flight credential rotation
prompt:
Implement the nsxpolicy Go package in this repository. The package is a focused VCF 9.1 NSX Policy API client for the two operations recorded in docs/contract.json. Keep the exported API already declared in nsxpolicy/client.go. Encode the exact methods, paths, query names, JSON names, and response shapes from the locked contract. URL-escape each path parameter, set Accept: application/json on every attempt, set Content-Type: application/json for UpdateGroupForDomain, and use HTTP Basic authentication. Optional list query parameters and optional Group JSON fields must be absent when unset; explicit pointer values such as false, 0, or an empty string must still be sent.

Credentials are rotated concurrently with traffic. RotateCredentials must be race-free. Every HTTP attempt must snapshot the current credentials immediately before dispatch. A 401 may be retried exactly once, and only when the credential generation changed after the rejected attempt was authenticated. The retry must rebuild the request with the latest credentials while preserving its method, escaped URI, query, headers, and body. Do not retry a 401 when credentials are unchanged, do not retry more than once, honor context cancellation, close response bodies, and return useful non-2xx errors.

The protected loopback contract mock serves only ListGroupForDomain and UpdateGroupForDomain and records requests for verification. No live VMware endpoint is used. Do not modify docs/, internal/contractmock/, internal/acceptance/, or verify.sh. Run ./verify.sh before finishing.
